Luke is searching for an Ammonia (NH3) Analyzer that can be attached to an existing Eddy-Covariance measurement station located in an agriculture environment. Analyzer must function outdoors and provide a scientific accuracy and robustness for long-term environmental monitoring. The procurement entity invites the interested suppliers to participate in a market dialogue by sending their expression of interest and contact details (contact person, e-mail address) by e-mail to kirjaamo@luke.fi and copy to hankintatuki@luke.fi preferably by 9th of March 2026 at the latest. The e-mail should be titled/identified with a mark "Market Survey LUKE/377/02.10.01.00.05/2026, Ammonia Analyzer". The interested suppliers are also kindly asked in their e-mail to provide answers to the following questions: - Ammonia (NH3) is a reactive and sticky substance and adsorbs to the surfaces. How is this considered in the technical design and features of the device you supply? - Long-term environmental monitoring requires that the used measurement devices are usable under varying weather and are not overly sensitive to e.g. varying temperature. How is this considered in the technical design of the device you supply? - Analyzer must have a minimum sampling frequency of 10 Hz. What are the measurements ranges, accuracy/precision ranges and response time of the device at this sampling frequency you can supply? - Are there peer-viewed scientifical publications with your supplied device where it has been used for Eddy-Covariance flux measurements? If yes, please provide references. - What is the warranty time for your device? - What is the delivery time for your device? - What kind of maintenance or calibration does your device need and at what frequency? - Can you provide technical product sheets and user manual for your device? The procurement entity may also send further questions and/or draft procurement documents to interest suppliers for comments by email. The schedules presented and other information presented in this notice, such as the planned course of the market dialogue, are preliminary information that may change as the preparation progresses. This market consultation and the information provided in it do not bind or oblige the parties to anything, and do not oblige the procurement entity to make a purchase. All information provided is treated as confidential. Participants of the market consultation are not compensated for participating in the market dialogue, nor for the costs incurred by participating. The actual call for tenders will be published through the electronic Hanki tender service during spring 2026.

The role of the Guyanese Space Centre (CSG) Flight Safety teams is to ensure the protection of people, property, the environment and public health during a space operation (Launch Operation)

The Sapress project is an IT project which consists in integrating into the GUI a multi-launcher flight safety diagnostic tool currently used by the CSG Flight Safety teams called ‘Sedia Calisa generic’, and in executing some simple treatments. 
This tool is based on a CNES model, built on Sedia Calisa Ariane 5 code.
The overall objective is to have a flexible and configurable tool that is easily configurable according to the launcher’s architecture and dimensioning scenarios.
The first version will be qualified and tested for the new Ariane 6 launcher.
The content of the interfaces must be consistent overall with the other current tools used by the CSG (mainly the SCTV (Coordination, Processing and Visualization System)).

Les équipes Sauvegarde Vol du Centre Spatial Guyanais (CSG) ont pour rôle de s’assurer de la Protection des personnes, des biens, de l’environnement et de la santé publique lors d’une opération spatiale (Opération de lancement)

Le projet Sapress (Structure d'Accueil pour la Préparation des Soumissions Sauvegarde) est un projet informatique qui consiste globalement à intégrer en IHM un outil de réalisation de diagnostic sauvegarde vol multi-lanceurs utilisé actuellement par les équipes Sauvegarde Vol du CSG Sedia Calisa Générique et à réaliser quelques traitements simples. 
Cet outil est basé sur une maquette CNES, construite sur du code Sedia Calisa Ariane 5.
L’objectif global est de disposer d’un outil flexible et configurable facilement en fonction de l’architecture du lanceur et des scénarii dimensionnants.
La première version sera qualifiée et testée pour le nouveau lanceur Ariane 6.
Le contenu des interfaces devra globalement être cohérent des autres outils actuels utilisés par le CSG (principalement le SCTV (Système de Coordination, Traitement et Visualisation)

Supportleistungen","description":"Ziel der Ausschreibung ist die Beschaffung eines Arbiträren Wellenformgenerators (AWG) inkl. Supportleistungen für ein Jahr. Der durch den Auftragnehmer bereitzustellende arbiträre Wellenformgenerator (engl. Arbitrary Waveform Generator, AWG) ist ein elektronisches Messgerät, welches beliebige (d. h. \"arbiträre\") elektrische Signale erzeugen kann - also nicht nur einfache Sinus-, Rechteck- oder Dreieckssignale, wie bei herkömmlichen Funktionsgeneratoren, sondern hochkomplexe, selbst definierte Signalverläufe, zum Beispiel: - modulierte Signale für Mobilfunk (z. B. 5G / 6G), - pulsartige Anregungen für Radar- oder Lasersysteme, - reale Umgebungsbedingungen, wie sie später im Produktbetrieb auftreten würden. Das Entscheidende ist: Die Form des Signals muss komplett frei gewählt oder aus realen Daten importiert werden können.
